name: DataGridBulkActionBar
purpose: Reusable grid-specific action bar for the current row selection.

guidance.useWhen: Use when a grid workflow needs a selected-row summary plus contextual actions using the existing DataGridBulkAction contracts.
guidance.avoidWhen: Avoid for generic page actions or application business workflows that are not scoped to the current grid selection.
guidance.aiUsageNotes: Use the existing DataGridBulkAction and DataGridBulkActionContext contracts. Keep permissions, mutations, backend calls, and application workflow state outside this component.

accessibility: The selected-row summary uses status semantics and each action remains a normal VyrnForge button in the Tab order. The bar adds no custom keyboard model.
knownLimitations: Presentation and action-dispatch surface only; selection state, permissions, mutations, and backend workflows remain controlled by UniversalDataGrid or the consuming application.
